description.value: A year-round RV park on the Hart Highway in Prince George offering a shaded tenting area with flush washrooms and showers; the hosts bring a genuine northern cultural angle (Inuit carvings, trapline stories, northern photography) that distinguishes it from a plain highway stopover.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and provides strong evidence. The site confirms tent camping, showers, laundry, and free WiFi. Phone number 250-962-8848 appears in the website header but is absent from OSM tags. No explicit mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, bike tools, e-bike charging, or most other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone number; website header shows 250-962-8848 — phone added from website source.
OSM address is '7729 South Kelly Road' but website describes location as 'Hart Highway'; these may refer to the same location but the street address could not be confirmed from website text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active year-round campground with tent camping, showers, laundry, and free WiFi near Prince George — a practical and culturally distinctive stop for touring cyclists on the Hart Highway corridor.

wow_evidence: tent camping, showers, laundry, and free WiFi
